PH_REFUSED_BOM.condition: the input begins with a UTF-8, UTF-16 or UTF-32 byte-order mark
PH_REFUSED_BOM.prevents: that a BOM is accepted by one reader and treated as document content or rejected by another, so two readings of one file disagree about the first key or fail differently

PH_REFUSED_CONTROL_CHARACTER.condition: a string contains a raw character below U+0020
PH_REFUSED_CONTROL_CHARACTER.prevents: that an unescaped newline or NUL is read as string content, so a record's text and the bytes that carry it are read differently

PH_REFUSED_DEPTH.condition: containers are nested more deeply than max_depth
PH_REFUSED_DEPTH.prevents: that a deeply nested input consumes the reader's stack and its behaviour depends on the interpreter's recursion limit

PH_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_KEY.condition: an object repeats a key at any depth
PH_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_KEY.prevents: that two distinct documents collapse to one value, so the later value silently replaces the one a record was read as

PH_REFUSED_ENCODING.condition: the input bytes are not valid UTF-8
PH_REFUSED_ENCODING.prevents: that a reader's fallback encoding turns the same bytes into a different string, so an identity digest over the bytes and the text the rule was applied to disagree

PH_REFUSED_INTEGER_RANGE.condition: an integer's magnitude does not fit integer_bits
PH_REFUSED_INTEGER_RANGE.prevents: that an integer is exact in one reader and rounded to a double or silently truncated in another

PH_REFUSED_KEY_NOT_TEXT.condition: an object member name is not a JSON string
PH_REFUSED_KEY_NOT_TEXT.prevents: that a non-text key (a number, a bare word) is read as an object key by a reader that coerces it

PH_REFUSED_LONE_SURROGATE.condition: an escape encodes a high or low surrogate that is not paired
PH_REFUSED_LONE_SURROGATE.prevents: that a string Python holds as an unpaired surrogate is emitted to a UTF-8 sink, where it fails or is replaced by a different character

PH_REFUSED_NONFINITE.condition: a NaN or Infinity literal, or a number that overflows to infinity
PH_REFUSED_NONFINITE.prevents: that a value that is not JSON, or a finite literal whose value became infinite, is read as a number

PH_REFUSED_NUMBER_FORM.condition: a number is not in the canonical form this reader writes: a leading zero, a leading plus, -0, a missing fraction digit, or a bare .5
PH_REFUSED_NUMBER_FORM.prevents: that one value has several accepted spellings, so two byte strings parse to one number and a rewrite is invisible

PH_REFUSED_SIZE.condition: the input is larger than max_bytes
PH_REFUSED_SIZE.prevents: that a huge record is read in full before anything decides whether it is admissible, turning a reader into a memory denial-of-service

PH_REFUSED_SYNTAX.condition: the input is not JSON at all
PH_REFUSED_SYNTAX.prevents: that an empty, truncated or malformed document is read as an empty or partial value

PH_REFUSED_TRAILING_DATA.condition: non-whitespace bytes follow the top-level value
PH_REFUSED_TRAILING_DATA.prevents: that a second document appended to a record is ignored while the first is read and reported
